figurative_meaning_en: A bearer of extremely terrible news akin to death
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে যমদূতের মতো খবর এনে সকলকে শোকাহত করে দিল।
যখন ডাক্তার যমদূতের মতো মুখ করে এল, তখন আমরা বুঝলাম খারাপ খবর।
example_sentences_in_english: He came like a messenger of Yama, delivering news that plunged everyone into grief.
When the doctor approached with a face like the angel of death, we knew it was bad news.
history: Derived from Hindu mythology, where Yamadutas are the messengers of Yama, the god of death, who escort souls to the afterlife.
note: This idiom draws heavily from Puranic stories in Bengali folklore and literature.
